---
title: "Course Materials"
---

Welcome to the online materials for **Introduction to Data Science and Programming**.

The primary goal of this course is to develop **programming skills, problem-solving techniques, and algorithmic thinking**. Python is the programming language used as the practical environment for learning these concepts.

## Course structure

The course consists of 12 teaching weeks. Each lesson will gradually contain:

- concise theoretical notes;
- worked examples;
- practical exercises;
- additional practice tasks;
- solutions released when appropriate.

Assessment materials and preparation tasks for the two midterm tests and the final test will be added during the semester.

## Programming environment

The main programming environment for the course is planned to be **Google Colab**. It allows Python notebooks to be created and executed directly in a web browser.

::: {.callout-note}
The materials are version-controlled with Git and can be published through GitHub Pages. Moodle can therefore link to one continuously updated course website.
:::
